title: Route Experiments: results dashboard UX (variant deltas, guardrails, drilldowns)
creator: Tessa Morgan
description:
Design the Route Experiments results view in Console.

Scope
- Results dashboard for an experiment with A/B/n variants.
- Variant comparison table with deltas vs baseline.
- Guardrail status (latency/cost/error/quality) and clear “what happened / what do I do now” states.
- Drill-down slices by route/model/region.
- Links to audit history + configuration (read-only).

Primary users
- Platform engineers and ML engineers monitoring rollout safety and performance regressions.

Success criteria
- Users can answer within ~30s: “Is this experiment safe to continue?”, “Which variant is best on my key metrics?”, “Where is the regression (route/model/region)?”, “What changed and when?”.

Non-goals (for this ticket)
- Statistical significance UI beyond basic deltas/trends.
- Custom customer metric ingestion.

References
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/route-level-ab-testing-prd.json
- UX spec (drafting in parallel; this ticket should feed it): sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/console-route-experiments-ux-spec.json
- ADR-048 experiment attribution schema: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-048-experiment-metrics-attribution-schema.json

Deliverables
- Final wireframes for: (1) Results Overview, (2) Variant Compare, (3) Drill-down view, (4) Guardrail banner states, (5) Empty/error/stale-data states.
- UX copy for guardrails and “auto-stop / degraded” states.
- Interaction notes: time range selection, baseline selection, filtering, and loading behavior.
- Engineering handoff notes: expected data fields, charts, and performance constraints.

Acceptance criteria
- Baseline variant is clearly identified and changeable (default: control).
- Metrics are grouped: Performance (p50/p95/p99 latency), Reliability (error rate), Economics (cost/token, tokens/sec), Optional Quality (eval score stream).
- Guardrail status is visible above the fold with a clear severity and a link to underlying metric + threshold.
- Results can be filtered/sliced by: route, model_id, region (with sensible defaults and anti-cardinality UI constraints).
- Handles attribution drop / data quality warnings without breaking UX (banner + guidance).
- Includes clear “last updated” / staleness indicator and aligns with propagation lag semantics.
comments: 2025-02-10 (Tessa Morgan): Creating this for results/dashboard UX. Please align with metrics schema constraints and avoid high-cardinality UI patterns. Key question: what’s the minimum drill-down that’s still useful (route/model/region) without implying arbitrary slicing.

2025-02-12 (Alicia Perez): First pass wireframes drafted: Overview (guardrail banner + KPI tiles + trend sparklines), Compare (table with deltas), Drilldown (filter bar + chart grid). Open questions: baseline selector location; where to surface attribution drop rate (banner vs metric).

2025-02-13 (Logan Wright): Telemetry note: not all dimensions are guaranteed in every aggregation window (esp. model_id in some legacy paths). Recommend UI gracefully degrades and shows “Unavailable” instead of empty charts. Also: keep region list limited to known regions from config to avoid exploding filter list.

2025-02-14 (Sean Gallagher): SRE request: guardrail banner must be explicit about whether it is “Soft-stop recommended” vs “Auto-stopped” vs “Degraded (no stop)”. Also need a runbook link when guardrail triggers. (We can use a generic link placeholder now; ENG will wire later.)

2025-02-18 (Kenji Nakamura): UX feedback: Compare table should default to “% change vs baseline” for latency/cost and “absolute delta” for error rate (percentage points). Users get confused when error rate is displayed as % change. Suggested: small inline labels “pp” for error rate deltas.

2025-02-19 (Alicia Perez): Updated designs with error-rate delta as percentage points and added explicit baseline chip (Control). Added ‘Guardrails’ section: each guardrail shows metric, threshold, status, and a “View details” deep link that applies the relevant filter/time range.

2025-02-20 (Chloe Martin): Data/API constraints: results API will likely return a limited set of aggregates per experiment + variant; drill-down will call a separate endpoint with query params. Please specify exactly which filters must be supported for v1 to keep query cost contained.

2025-02-21 (Alicia Perez): Proposed v1 drill-down requirements: (1) region filter (single-select), (2) model filter (single-select), (3) route is fixed (experiment’s route set) but if experiment spans multiple routes, allow route switcher limited to configured routes only. No free-form search on raw paths; show normalized route IDs.

2025-02-24 (Allison Grant): Observability consistency: please use p95 and p99 for guardrail defaults; p50 is useful but shouldn’t drive guardrails. Also ensure terminology matches dashboards: “Attribution drop rate” and “Propagation lag”.

2025-02-26 (Alicia Perez): Added ‘Data quality’ banner state: triggers when attribution drop rate exceeds threshold or when results are stale. Copy: “Results may be incomplete. Check attribution and config propagation.” Includes links to dashboards (placeholder) and “What does this mean?” tooltip.

2025-03-03 (Marissa Cole): Product feedback: We need a clearer “Decision summary” section for beta users: winner/loser isn’t stat-sig, but we can show ‘Best on selected metric’ and highlight tradeoffs. Add a selector: “Optimize for: latency | cost | error | quality”. It should change sorting and highlight, not claim significance.

2025-03-05 (Alicia Perez): Implemented “Optimize for” selector in designs; added disclaimer text under header: “Deltas are descriptive. Statistical significance is not calculated.” Sorting behavior specified. Also added a ‘Stop experiment’ CTA location note (gated by RBAC) but left actual permission logic to ENG.

2025-03-07 (Jordan Lee): Please ensure users can see which stickiness key was used (or if missing) somewhere in results details; debugging skew issues is common. Suggest: a small “Assignment” card in sidebar with stickiness precedence + config version.

2025-03-10 (Alicia Perez): Added “Assignment & config” panel: stickiness key source (e.g., customer_id / header / fallback), config version, last propagated timestamp, and link to audit history. Not exposing raw hash inputs in UI (kept for internal debug endpoint only).

2025-03-12 (Dylan Brooks): Eng review: looks good. Please add explicit empty state for “No traffic yet” and “Variant 0 traffic” (allocation issue). Also call out performance expectations: charts should load progressively and default time range should be last 1h for active experiments to keep queries cheap.

2025-03-13 (Alicia Perez): Added empty states + ‘Variant receiving 0% of traffic’ warning callout. Updated interaction notes: default time range last 1h (active) / last 24h (stopped), progressive loading, and skeleton states.
2025-03-18 (Tessa Morgan): Final review complete. Designs approved for beta. Please ensure Confluence UX spec is updated with these final frames + copy; linking this ticket in the spec.
2025-03-21 (Alicia Perez): Handoff complete: exported frames, added redlines and copy deck, and posted notes to Console eng channel. Marking Done.
